sentences.en: And so it's wishful thinking.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一种一厢情愿的想法。

sentences.en: Well, Elizabeth, you report on religion for the time.
sentences.zh: 那么，伊丽莎白，你为《时报》报道宗教新闻。

sentences.en: So why did it come to be that you were trying to make sense of what happened at the Lincoln Memorial?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么你会试图去理清林肯纪念堂发生的事情呢？

sentences.en: Well, whenever there is an event that catches the nation's attention on anything related to religion, that's where I want to be.
sentences.zh: 嗯，每当发生任何与宗教相关的事件引起全国关注时，那都是我想去的地方。

sentences.en: Like, that's the story that I want to dig into and better understand the context for this and the religious and cultural and political underpinnings around,
sentences.zh: 就像，那是我想深入挖掘的故事，以更好地理解其背景，以及围绕着，

sentences.en: in this case, this group of Catholic students.
sentences.zh: 在这个案例中，这群天主教学生周围的宗教、文化和政治基础。

sentences.en: And for me, it was especially interesting because the last time that the country was really fixated
sentences.zh: 对我来说，这特别有趣，因为上一次国家真正关注

sentences.en: on a Catholic high school and Catholic high school boys was during the Brett Kavanaugh hearings.
sentences.zh: 天主教高中和天主教高中男生是在布雷特·卡瓦诺的听证会期间。

sentences.en: And so now that that same demographic of kid was in the news again, I wanted to better understand the Catholic school environment that they're coming from in Northern Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 所以现在同样的人群再次出现在新闻中，我想更好地了解他们来自肯塔基州北部的天主教学校环境。

sentences.en: You know, why were they there to march in the March for Life and in this kind of conflict to begin with?
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们为什么会去参加“为生命而游行”，并陷入这种冲突？

sentences.en: And how did you do that?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: So I got on a plane on Sunday morning and flew from D.C.
sentences.zh: 所以我周日早上坐飞机从华盛顿特区飞往

sentences.en: to Covington, Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州的卡温顿。

sentences.en: And I landed in Covington and drove straight to the school.
sentences.zh: 我降落在卡温顿，直接开车去了学校。

sentences.en: It's not very far from the airport.
sentences.zh: 离机场不远。

sentences.en: You go down the Dixie Highway, sloping hill towards the Ohio River.
sentences.zh: 你沿着迪克西公路走，经过一段斜坡，朝俄亥俄河方向。

sentences.en: And on the left, as I was approaching, there's Covington Catholic High School.
sentences.zh: 当我靠近时，左边就是卡温顿天主教高中。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's the kind of place where when they say the Pledge of Allegiance, they actually change the end.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这是一个在宣誓效忠时，他们实际上会修改结尾的地方。

sentences.en: So it says, with liberty and justice for all, born and unborn.
sentences.zh: 上面写着：为了所有人的自由与正义，无论出生与否。

sentences.en: In other words, this is a very conservative Catholic community.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，这是一个非常保守的天主教社区。

sentences.en: And those values are really instilled in the young men at the school.
sentences.zh: 这些价值观确实深深植根于这所学校的年轻学子心中。

sentences.en: I spoke with one parent, dad, of one of the kids who was actually at the March for Life, was in the scene at the mall, and he immediately used an expletive with me
sentences.zh: 我采访了一位家长，其中一名当时确实参加了“为生命而游行”（March for Life）并出现在商场现场的孩子的父亲，他立刻对我爆了粗口，

sentences.en: to describe what he thought was really unfair coverage by the media of the incident.
sentences.zh: 用来形容他认为媒体对该事件极其不公的报道。

sentences.en: And he said, you know, it should be reported how great these young men did in the face of these protesters who were trying to bait them.
sentences.zh: 他说，你应该报道这些年轻人在面对那些试图挑衅他们的抗议者时表现得有多么出色。

sentences.en: And things like the left has an agenda and facts don't really matter to them if it goes against their agenda.
sentences.zh: 还有诸如左派有自己的议程，如果事实违背了他们的议程，事实对他们来说就无关紧要之类的话。

sentences.en: So it was very clear that for the immediate community of parents and CovCath students, they were under attack and they felt like they were under siege.
sentences.zh: 所以很明显，对于家长和科文顿天主教高中的学生这个直接群体来说，他们觉得自己受到了攻击，处于被围困的状态。

sentences.en: Then that evening, I went to mass at the Basilica in Covington, which is the main church for the Catholics in that area.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，我去了科文顿的大教堂参加弥撒，那是该地区天主教徒的主要教堂。

sentences.en: It's where the bishop is.
sentences.zh: 那是主教所在地。

sentences.en: And during the mass, the priests talked about the importance of the March for Life and fighting abortion rights.
sentences.zh: 弥撒期间，神父们谈到了“为生命而游行”以及反对堕胎权的重要性。

sentences.en: And then at the end, one of the priests got up and made a short announcement saying, you know, I'm sure everyone's heard what's going on at CovCath.
sentences.zh: 最后，其中一位神父站起来做了一个简短的声明，他说，我相信大家都听说了科文顿天主教高中发生的事情。

sentences.en: And please pray.
sentences.zh: 请祈祷。

sentences.en: Please pray for the community.
sentences.zh: 请为这个社区祈祷。

sentences.en: Please pray that the truth will become known.
sentences.zh: 请祈祷真相大白。

sentences.en: It's really hard when you see your loved ones up in the media.
sentences.zh: 当你看到你所爱的人在媒体上被曝光时，这真的很难受。

sentences.en: And we trust that God will work all of this out.
sentences.zh: 我们相信上帝会解决这一切。

sentences.en: And on the way out of mass, there was a man who was really angry with the priests and with the bishop.
sentences.zh: 在散场时，有一位男士对神父和主教感到非常愤怒。

sentences.en: And, you know, he pulled one of the priests aside and said, how dare the bishop apologize for the students' behavior with that first statement that the diocese and the school did.
sentences.zh: 他把其中一位神父拉到一边说，主教怎么敢用教区和学校发表的那份初步声明来为学生的行为道歉。

sentences.en: So even though ultimately the Catholic diocese there was at this mass speaking about protecting these boys,
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管当地天主教教区最终在弥撒上谈到了保护这些男孩，

sentences.en: these members of the community and this man in particular felt that the church had betrayed these families and this town by ever questioning them in the first place.
sentences.zh: 但这些社区成员，尤其是这位男士，觉得教会从一开始就质疑他们，是对这些家庭和这个城镇的背叛。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, and the dad told me, we trust the school and we trust the diocese, that they will protect their flock.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那位父亲告诉我，我们信任学校，我们信任教区，他们会保护他们的羊群。

sentences.en: And what do you think he meant by that?
sentences.zh: 你认为他这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: Protect their flock.
sentences.zh: 保护他们的羊群。

sentences.en: As a religion reporter, I hear that phrase, protect the flock.
sentences.zh: 作为一名宗教记者，我经常听到“保护羊群”这个词。

sentences.en: And it reminds me of everything else going on in America right now with religious conservatives and this broader idea that white Christians seem to feel under attack, right?
sentences.zh: 这让我想起了现在美国发生的其他一切事情，宗教保守派以及这种更广泛的观念，即白人基督徒似乎感到自己受到了攻击，对吧？

sentences.en: And that they've needed a defender, which really has become President Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们需要一个捍卫者，而这个人实际上已经变成了特朗普总统。

sentences.en: And so in Covington with the Cove-Cath kids, you know, this isn't about President Trump, right?
sentences.zh: 所以在科文顿，对于科文顿天主教高中的孩子们来说，这与特朗普总统无关，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, all that they're doing is wearing the Make America Great Again hat.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们所做的只是戴着“让美国再次伟大”的帽子。

sentences.en: But it is about who protects you and who will be your champion when you feel under attack.
sentences.zh: 但这关乎谁来保护你，以及当你感到受到攻击时，谁会成为你的捍卫者。

sentences.en: And how do you band together to defend your traditions?
sentences.zh: 你们如何团结起来捍卫自己的传统？

sentences.en: It's fascinating, Elizabeth, that you were drawn to this story with the Brett Kavanaugh story in mind.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白，你带着布雷特·卡瓦诺的故事来关注这个故事，这很有趣。

sentences.en: Because hearing this all reminds me of a story that I haven't been able to forget.
sentences.zh: 因为听到这一切让我想起了一个我一直无法忘记的故事。

sentences.en: That the Times published following Kavanaugh's confirmation as a Supreme Court justice, he actually returned to his alma mater, Georgetown Prep, an all-boys high school Catholic,
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》在卡瓦诺被确认为最高法院大法官后发表了一篇报道，他实际上回到了他的母校乔治城预科学校，那是一所全男生的天主教高中，

sentences.en: like Cove Catholic, for an alumni event.
sentences.zh: 就像科文顿天主教高中一样，参加了一个校友活动。

sentences.en: I think it was a homecoming football game.
sentences.zh: 我想那是一场返校橄榄球赛。

sentences.en: And when he got there, he was applauded and treated as kind of a heroic figure by the current students and their parents, by the school.
sentences.zh: 当他到达那里时，他受到了在校学生、家长和学校的鼓掌欢迎，并被视为一种英雄人物。

sentences.en: And he's described as being sort of engulfed at this event by his former classmates.
sentences.zh: 据描述，他在这次活动中被昔日的同学们簇拥着。

sentences.en: These very same men whose names had come up over and over again as witnesses and character testimonials during the confirmation hearing.
sentences.zh: 正是这些人在确认听证会期间，名字一次又一次地作为证人和品格证明人被提及。

sentences.en: Tobin, Timmy.
sentences.zh: 托宾，蒂米。

sentences.en: And when you talk about this visual of protecting the flock, it feels to me kind of like the same image.
sentences.zh: 当你谈到保护羊群的画面时，我觉得这和那个画面很像。

sentences.en: It does.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's almost like there's this transition from villain to hero.
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像是从反派到英雄的转变。

sentences.en: I mean, that's what's happening at Covington right now, I think.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这就是现在科文顿正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: Covington Catholic is pretty similar to Georgetown Prep, except maybe it's not known in quite the same elite way.
sentences.zh: 科文顿天主教高中和乔治城预科学校非常相似，只是它可能没有那么出名。

sentences.en: It's a bit more suburban.
sentences.zh: 它更偏向郊区一点。

sentences.en: Maybe the families aren't quite as wealthy.
sentences.zh: 也许家庭没有那么富有。

sentences.en: But that brotherhood and that cultural pride of, you know, sticking with your brother in the midst of distress and outsider attacks,
sentences.zh: 但那种兄弟情谊和文化自豪感，即在困境和外界攻击中与你的兄弟站在一起，

sentences.en: that's very similar to what's going on on the ground right now.
sentences.zh: 这与现在当地发生的事情非常相似。

sentences.en: But isn't the notion of protecting the flock, isn't that kind of true of any community in the country?
sentences.zh: 但“保护羊群”这个概念，难道不适用于全国任何一个社区吗？

sentences.en: Isn't that in some ways?
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上来说不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In fact, maybe even a good thing for a community to circle around its own members when they feel they're being attacked.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当社区成员感到受到攻击时，团结起来保护他们，这甚至可能是一件好事。

sentences.en: Of course it is.
sentences.zh: 当然是。

sentences.en: And so what's so interesting is it now becomes the question of, well, which of those groups have power and which of those groups need protecting?
sentences.zh: 所以最有趣的是，现在的问题变成了，那么，这些群体中哪些拥有权力，哪些群体需要保护？

sentences.en: What's so interesting about the coverage of Friday's videos was how much of it mentioned something called privilege.
sentences.zh: 关于周五视频的报道最有趣的地方在于，其中有多少提到了所谓的“特权”。

sentences.en: What's so fascinating about all of these attacks is how inverted they are.
sentences.zh: 所有这些攻击最令人着迷的地方在于它们是多么的颠倒黑白。

sentences.en: These are high school kids from Kentucky.
sentences.zh: 这些是来自肯塔基州的高中生。

sentences.en: They're far less privileged, in fact, than virtually everyone who has called for them to be destroyed on the basis they have too much privilege.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们远没有那些以他们拥有过多特权为由呼吁摧毁他们的人那么有特权。

sentences.en: And so for the people of Covecath and the Catholic community there in northern Kentucky, the aggressor is the big bad liberal media.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于科文顿天主教高中的人和肯塔基州北部的天主教社区来说，侵略者是邪恶的自由派媒体。

sentences.en: The media don't pause for a moment before casting judgment.
sentences.zh: 媒体在做出评判之前片刻都没有停顿。

sentences.en: CNN legal analyst Bakari Sellers suggested one of the boys should be, quote, punched in the face.
sentences.zh: CNN法律分析师巴卡里·塞勒斯建议其中一个男孩应该被“打脸”。

sentences.en: Longtime CNN contributor Kathy Griffin seemed to encourage a mob to rise up and hurt these boys.
sentences.zh: 长期担任CNN撰稿人的凯西·格里芬似乎在鼓励暴民起来伤害这些男孩。

sentences.en: Quote, name these kids.
sentences.zh: “说出这些孩子的名字。”

sentences.en: I want names.
sentences.zh: 我要名字。

sentences.en: Shame them.
sentences.zh: 羞辱他们。

sentences.en: If you think these efforts wouldn't dox you in a heartbeat, think again.
sentences.zh: 如果你认为这些努力不会让你立刻被曝光个人信息，那你就再想想吧。

sentences.en: The left that is determined to attack President Trump and conservative politics and policies and ideals and traditions as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 左派决心尽可能多地攻击特朗普总统以及保守派的政治、政策、理想和传统。

sentences.en: To attack the white male identity.
sentences.zh: 攻击白人男性身份。

sentences.en: Yes, to attack the white male identity.
sentences.zh: 是的，攻击白人男性身份。

sentences.en: And then on the other side.
sentences.zh: 然后是另一边。

sentences.en: So a high school in Kentucky took a field trip to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 肯塔基州的一所高中去华盛顿特区进行了一次实地考察。

sentences.en: And in the middle of it decided to take a racist detour to the indigenous people's march.
sentences.zh: 在考察过程中，他们决定对原住民游行进行一次种族主义的绕道。

sentences.en: People say, well, wait a minute.
sentences.zh: 人们说，等等。

sentences.en: Is there any better example of white Christian power in America right now than President Trump's election?
sentences.zh: 在美国，还有比特朗普总统当选更好的白人基督教权力的例子吗？

sentences.en: And so both sides genuinely believe that their side should have power, that they don't, and that the other side is trying to rob them of their power.
sentences.zh: 所以双方都真诚地认为他们的一方应该拥有权力，而他们却没有，另一方正试图剥夺他们的权力。

sentences.en: And in that case, the outcome seems kind of preordained.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，结果似乎是预先注定的。

sentences.en: Everybody will go to their corner.
sentences.zh: 每个人都会退回到自己的阵营。

sentences.en: They will be angry.
sentences.zh: 他们会很愤怒。

sentences.en: And no one will have a meaningful conversation about, say, what happened on the steps of the monument in Washington.
sentences.zh: 没有人会就华盛顿纪念碑台阶上发生的事情进行有意义的对话。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Nuance disappears and the realities that different communities face disappear.
sentences.zh: 细微差别消失了，不同社区面临的现实也消失了。

sentences.en: Everyone has their own community and their ideas about, you know, how to protect your own flock.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有自己的社区，以及关于如何保护自己羊群的想法。

sentences.en: And so what happens is when communities become so busy protecting their own flock, the facts about the
sentences.zh: 所以当社区忙于保护自己的羊群时，关于局势的事实，

sentences.en: situation or the more unseemly parts of it that are harder to confront for either side, those become obscured.
sentences.zh: 或者其中双方都难以面对的更不体面的部分，就会变得模糊不清。

sentences.en: Elizabeth, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks so much, Michael.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, President Trump expressed support for the students at Covington Catholic High School,
sentences.zh: 周二，特朗普总统表达了对科文顿天主教高中学生的支持，

sentences.en: writing on Twitter, quote, the students of Covington have become symbols of fake news and how evil it can be.
sentences.zh: 他在推特上写道：“科文顿的学生已经成为假新闻的象征，以及它有多么邪恶。”

sentences.en: They have captivated the attention of the world, he wrote, and I know they will use it for good, maybe even to bring people together.
sentences.zh: 他写道，他们吸引了全世界的关注，我知道他们会善用这一点，甚至可能将人们团结起来。

sentences.en: It started off unpleasant, but can end in a dream.
sentences.zh: 开始时可能不愉快，但可以以梦想告终。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用已解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用一个月，而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间去了解付费墙后的内容，看看《纽约时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载该应用，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他事情。

sentences.en: The opportunity to end all this is staring us right in the face.
sentences.zh: 结束这一切的机会就在我们眼前。

sentences.en: That's why we'll vote on this legislation on the Senate floor this week.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们本周将在参议院投票表决这项立法。

sentences.en: On Tuesday,
sentences.zh: 周二，

sentences.en: Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell and Senate Minority Leader Chuck Schumer said they would put forward two competing bills to reopen the government that will be voted on tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 参议院多数党领袖米奇·麦康奈尔和参议院少数党领袖查克·舒默表示，他们将提出两项相互竞争的法案来重启政府，并将于明天进行投票。

sentences.en: All that needs to happen is for our Democratic friends to agree that it's time to put the country ahead of politics, take yes for an answer, and vote to put the standoff behind us.
sentences.zh: 现在只需要我们的民主党朋友同意，是时候把国家置于政治之上了，接受这个结果，并投票让我们摆脱僵局。

sentences.en: One bill, backed by President Trump and Republicans, would include $5.7 billion for Trump's proposed border wall in exchange for temporary protection for undocumented immigrants,
sentences.zh: 一项由特朗普总统和共和党人支持的法案将包括57亿美元用于特朗普提议的边境墙，以换取对无证移民的临时保护，

sentences.en: including DREAMers, protected by DACA.
sentences.zh: 包括受DACA保护的“梦想者”。

sentences.en: In exchange for the wall, the president offers only limited temporary protections for DACA and TPS, protections he single-handedly removed.
sentences.zh: 作为换取边境墙的条件，总统只提供有限的临时保护，而这些保护正是他一手取消的。

sentences.en: So it's sort of like bargaining for stolen goods.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像是在为赃物讨价还价。

sentences.en: I hope it will roundly be defeated on Thursday.
sentences.zh: 我希望它在周四会被彻底否决。

sentences.en: The other bill, backed by Democrats, would simply fund the government for several weeks without providing money for a border wall.
sentences.zh: 另一项由民主党人支持的法案将简单地为政府提供几周的资金，而不提供边境墙的资金。

sentences.en: People are saying, isn't there a way out of this mess?
sentences.zh: 人们在问，难道没有办法摆脱这种混乱吗？

sentences.en: Isn't there a way to get government services open first, and then debate what we should do for border security?
sentences.zh: 难道没有办法先开放政府服务，然后再讨论我们应该为边境安全做些什么吗？

sentences.en: Well, now there's a way.
sentences.zh: 嗯，现在有办法了。

sentences.en: Neither bill is expected to win enough votes to pass.
sentences.zh: 预计两项法案都不会获得足够的票数通过。

sentences.en: But the Times reports that they could usher in a more collaborative tone, and eventually lead to a bipartisan compromise that would end the shutdown.
sentences.zh: 但《纽约时报》报道称，它们可能会带来一种更具合作性的基调，并最终促成两党妥协，从而结束政府停摆。

sentences.en: And the Supreme Court on Tuesday revived the Trump administration's ban on transgender people in the military, saying it could go into effect,
sentences.zh: 周二，最高法院恢复了特朗普政府对跨性别者参军的禁令，称其可以生效，

sentences.en: while several cases challenging it move to the lower courts.
sentences.zh: 同时几起挑战该禁令的案件正在下级法院审理。

sentences.en: The 5-4 decision was a victory for the Trump administration, and means the policy, which has been widely denounced by advocates for transgender rights,
sentences.zh: 这项5比4的裁决是特朗普政府的胜利，意味着这项被跨性别权利倡导者广泛谴责、

sentences.en: and championed by religious conservatives, will likely be in effect until at least 2020.
sentences.zh: 并受到宗教保守派拥护的政策，很可能会至少持续到2020年。

sentences.en: A few hours later, the Supreme Court handed the president a defeat by taking no action on DACA, which Trump has tried to revoke, but which has been kept in place by federal courts.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，最高法院对DACA采取不作为态度，这让总统遭遇了挫败。特朗普曾试图撤销DACA，但它一直被联邦法院维持。

sentences.en: The president wants the Supreme Court to overturn those court rulings, and is seeking to use DACA as leverage in his negotiations with Democrats over the government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 总统希望最高法院推翻这些法院裁决，并试图利用DACA作为他与民主党就政府停摆进行谈判的筹码。

sentences.en: The high court's silence on the matter almost certainly means Trump will not be able to end DACA this year, as he had hoped,
sentences.zh: 最高法院对此事的沉默几乎肯定意味着特朗普今年将无法如愿终结DACA，

sentences.en: or use the fate of those it protects to end the shutdown.
sentences.zh: 也无法利用受其保护者的命运来结束政府停摆。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。
